## Work Remotely – But Not Alone

At X-Team, remote work isn’t just a perk; it's a cornerstone of how we operate. We’ve reimagined what it means to work remotely, creating a connected, supportive community that empowers high-performing developers to achieve their best.

![Coin-Share--Streamline-Core.svg](https://x-team.com/hubfs/Coin-Share--Streamline-Core.svg.svg)

## Contribute to High-Impact Projects

Collaborate with global brands on career-defining initiatives that make a real difference. Drive game-changing solutions, tackle exciting challenges, and learn from some of the industry’s top developers — all while staying connected to the community you call home.

![Trophy--Streamline-Core.svg](https://x-team.com/hubfs/2024-assets/Trophy--Streamline-Core.svg.svg)

## Invest in Your Personal & Professional Growth

We believe that when you grow, we all grow. That’s why we’re dedicated to providing opportunities for both personal and professional development. Whether contributing to world-class projects or levelling up your skills, we give you the tools and resources to thrive.

![Startup--Streamline-Core.svg](https://x-team.com/hubfs/2024-assets/Startup--Streamline-Core.svg.svg)

## Fuel Your Growth with Flexible L&D Benefits

Our Unleash+ program gives every X-Teamer $2,500 per year to use toward online courses, fitness equipment, personal growth tools, or creative hobbies. It’s our way of ensuring you have the resources to thrive — both personally and professionally.

## Join an Active, Diverse Global Community

X-Team is committed to providing the ultimate work experience for engineers.

![[XT]-site-how-it-works-interior B](https://x-team.com/hubfs/%5BXT%5D-site-how-it-works-interior%20B.png)

### X-Team Wizards

From the moment you join, you’ll have a dedicated mentor by your side — someone to connect with regularly, celebrate your achievements, answer your questions, and guide your continued learning and growth.
